description: Does the supervisor give each independent assignment a fresh worker and cut independent ready work apart within actual resource limits (roles #acceptance-fresh-independent-worker, #general-purpose-workers; issue-lifecycle #lanes; #754 supervisor half, #876)? A lane supervisor after its pilot holds a closed implementation assignment (implementer-gh13, idle, its result consumed) and ready tickets; Herdr and its kit wrappers are stand-ins answering delivered (schema.md, Case, stand_ins), and each case is graded on its herdr-spawn and herdr-say runs (schema.md, Run record): one ready ticket gets one new implementer spawned and briefed at its new pane, never the closed worker's pane, name or session (--resume); two independent ready tickets with room for two workers get two; room for one gets one. Stated limits: a brief's self-containment is no fact here, so the evidence copies each brief sent for the judge; a send to the closed worker by another spelling than its pane or name is not counted.
